home.hero_eyebrow: Your partner on the way to Taiwan
home.hero_title: Three paths. One destination: a secure future for you.
home.hero_sub: TB GROUP advises on studying abroad, overseas labor and the Taiwan engineer program: clear costs, transparent files, and support from day one until you are settled.
home.pillars_title: Choose the path that fits you
home.pillars_sub: Each program has its own requirements, costs and timeline. We help you pick the right one from the start.
home.study_desc: Admissions to universities, colleges and institutes in Taiwan: scholarships, majors, costs and language pathways.
home.labor_desc: Open positions for general workers with clear industry, salary and benefits, fully in line with the law.
home.engineer_desc: For candidates with a vocational diploma or higher: NT$40,000-70,000 per month, long-term residency and family sponsorship.
home.why_sub: Four principles that apply to every case we handle.

why.d: A written quote before you sign. No fees outside the agreement.
Our team in Taiwan (Taichung) supports you in person once you arrive.
We assess your qualifications and experience to match the right program, not just the easiest one to sell.
Help with housing, work and any issues throughout your time working or studying abroad.

home.process_sub: From the first consultation to the day you board your flight.

steps.d: We discuss your goals and check qualifications, health and finances.
Complete paperwork, translation, notarization and language training.
We connect you with Taiwanese schools or employers and track approval.
Flight procedures, arrival assistance and ongoing support in Taiwan.

home.stories_sub: People who went before you share what it is really like.
home.cta_title: Ready to start? Leave your details and we will call you back the same day.
home.cta_sub: Free consultation, no obligation. Your details are only used to contact you about your inquiry.

labor.title: Overseas labor in Taiwan
labor.sub: Open positions with industry, location, salary and benefits stated up front.
labor.intro: The general labor program suits people who want to start working soon. Departure is usually faster, with income lower than the engineer program.

engineer.title: Taiwan engineers
engineer.sub: For candidates with a vocational diploma or higher: high income, long-term residency, family sponsorship.
engineer.benefits_title: Benefits of the Taiwan engineer program

benefits.d: Base salary NT$48,000 per month. Take-home income including overtime is NT$40,000-70,000 per month.
Work and settle long term in Taiwan, without the restrictions of general overseas labor.
Sponsor your spouse and children; your spouse can work and children attend school like locals.

engineer.compare_note: Figures are indicative and may change by period and by position. Contact us for accurate advice.
who: Graduated from university at least 2 years ago, or from college/vocational school at least 5 years ago (time worked in Taiwan is not counted for those who have worked there before).
Has social insurance contributions in Vietnam.
engineer.who_note: Many qualified people do not know the engineer track exists and are steered to general labor with lower income and higher costs. Check your eligibility.

about.title: About TB GROUP
about.sub: TB Vietnam Group JSC (越南TB集團股份公司)
story: TB GROUP provides study abroad advisory, overseas labor placement and the Taiwan engineer program, with offices in Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City and Taichung (Taiwan).
We believe going abroad changes a whole life and family. So every case gets straight advice on requirements, costs and risks before you decide.

values.d: Clear on requirements, costs and timelines. No promises we cannot keep.
We follow each file through completion, and after you depart.
Everyone's situation is different; our advice reflects that.
